Auto-Mate one input, anything done.

A floating input box summoned by a global hotkey. Type what you want done. Dry-run before every change. No cloud in the loop.

THE THREE LANES

One input,
three places it can act.

Auto-Mate classifies every input in one small language-model call. The classifier does not act on the input; it decides which planner takes it. Then Auto-Mate previews the plan for you and waits for a keystroke. No action runs invisibly.

L·01

Machine lane

Typed action library for the things you do on your own filesystem and processes. Every action shows a preview before it runs. Overwrites and deletes leave an undo record so you can reverse them.

  • Read, write, move, copy, trash files
  • Launch and quit applications
  • Take screenshots, read from and write to the clipboard
  • Kill a stuck process on a port
  • Run a shell command, gated per invocation
L·02

Browser lane

Bundled Chromium with a sandboxed profile. Auto-Mate does not touch your real Chrome profile unless you explicitly whitelist a domain. Actions are typed, not free-form scripts, and every session writes a signed activity log.

  • Navigate, click, type, select, submit
  • Extract text and HTML from any selector
  • Download files to a chosen folder
  • Accessibility-tree selectors survive markup churn
  • Per-domain whitelist for cookies and uploads
L·03

Fleet lane

Auto-Mate reads ~/.vf/agents/ on startup, catalogues every peer, and exposes their capabilities in the input as commands. Route a research brief to Re-Kon, a message to VF Mail, a filing to FileIT, all without leaving the input box.

  • Local Unix socket or named-pipe transport
  • HMAC-signed with a shared local secret
  • Autocomplete of every peer capability
  • Nothing on the network, ever
  • Buyer can disable fleet entirely at any time
SAFETY BY DEFAULT

Every change
shows before it happens.

Auto-Mate never runs a machine-changing or browser-executing action without a preview and a confirmation keystroke. The preview shows exactly what will happen: file paths, diffs, commands, target URLs. Read-only actions can be configured to skip the confirm gate; irreversible actions never can.

S·01 · CONFIRM PANEL

Preview before you press Enter

Colour-coded by reversibility: green for read-only, blue for reversible writes, amber for irreversible changes. Read the plan, edit it as JSON if you like, then confirm.

plan · rename 14 files in ~/Downloads IMG_2201.PNG → img_2201.png reversible IMG_2202.PNG → img_2202.png reversible ... IMG_2214.PNG → img_2214.png reversible press Enter to run · E to edit · Esc to cancel
S·02 · UNDO LOG

Reversible where possible

Every overwrite and non-trash delete leaves a sidecar with the prior content. Run automate undo <invocation-id> to reverse. Deletes default to OS trash, not immediate removal, so a wrong move is a Cmd+Z, not a support ticket.

automate undo 8e8f7c14 restore 14 files from .automate-undo/8e8f7c14/ restored · 14 · OK
S·03 · SHELL GATE

Shell commands are gated

The shell action is behind an explicit per-invocation confirm and a global on-off switch. The preview shows the exact command string and the effective working directory. There is no path from a language model prompt injection to a silent shell run.

plan · shell command cmd pnpm install cwd /home/vince/projects/vfempire-site shell action · irreversible press Enter to run · Esc to cancel
S·04 · BROWSER SANDBOX

Bundled Chromium, isolated profile

Your real Chrome profile stays out of the loop. The bundled Chromium runs under ~/.vf/auto-mate/chromium/ with an ephemeral CDP token, bound to loopback. The language model can only produce typed browser actions; it cannot inject free-form JavaScript.

browser · navigate + click + download goto https://example.com/forms/tax click role=button name="Download PDF" save ~/Downloads/tax-Q3-2026.pdf
HOW IT COMPOSES WITH RE-KON

Type once,
route anywhere.

If Re-Kon is installed on the same machine, Auto-Mate discovers it through the local fleet bus and exposes its research capability in the input. A research brief typed into the floating input becomes a Re-Kon mission with no cloud round-trip.

Same machine, two agents, one flow

You press Ctrl+Space. Auto-Mate's floating input appears. You type: "everything filed by Meta in the EU in the last 90 days". Enter. 1. Auto-Mate classifies the intent as research. 2. Preview shows: Route to Re-Kon, new research mission. 3. You press Enter. 4. Auto-Mate opens ~/.vf/re-kon/agent.sock. 5. Auto-Mate calls research.mission.new with your brief. 6. Re-Kon plans, dispatches, ingests, distils. 7. Re-Kon publishes mission.completed on the bus. 8. Auto-Mate opens the dossier in a preview panel. No cloud round-trip. No VF servers. Everything stays on your box.

The same pattern extends to every VF agent that ships. VF Mail advertises mail.message.send. FileIT advertises tax.filing.submit. Auto-Mate discovers them, exposes them in autocomplete, and routes work to them exactly like it routes to Re-Kon. Read the Re-Kon page or the fleet overview for the full picture.

REQUIREMENTS

What Auto-Mate
needs on your box.

Auto-Mate is a native binary with a bundled Chromium download on first run. It uses a global hotkey and a small always-on process for the input window. It does not run browser sessions in the background unless you ask it to.

MACHINE

Modest hardware

  • Windows 10 or 11, macOS 13 or newer, mainstream Linux
  • x86_64 or arm64, 4 GB RAM free
  • 200 MB app, plus ~150 MB Chromium bundle on first-run
  • Accessibility permission on macOS for the global hotkey
MODEL BACKEND · BYO

Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

  • Local: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp
  • Cloud with your key: Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Grok, Together
  • Recommended: a small fast model for the classifier
  • No VF-provided model in the loop
HOTKEY · REBINDABLE

Global hotkey binding

  • Default: Ctrl+Space on Linux and Windows
  • Default: Cmd+Shift+Space on macOS, leaves Spotlight untouched
  • Rebindable to anything the OS lets you bind
  • Wayland global hotkey has a compositor caveat, listed in the install page

ASKED, ANSWERED

Six questions
every buyer asks.

Does Auto-Mate act without asking me?

Not by default. Every machine-changing or browser-executing action shows a preview and waits for a confirmation keystroke. Read-only actions can be configured to skip the gate. Irreversible actions never can. If a plan surprises you, cancel it with Esc, or edit the plan as JSON before running.

Can Auto-Mate see my real Chrome profile and cookies?

No, unless you explicitly whitelist a domain. Auto-Mate ships a bundled Chromium with its own isolated profile under ~/.vf/auto-mate/chromium/. Attach-to-existing-Chromium mode is a separate advanced feature planned for v1.1, off by default.

What stops a prompt injection from running a destructive shell command?

Three layers. First, the classifier returns typed JSON only, not free-form actions. Second, the shell action is behind a global on-off switch and a per-invocation confirm. Third, the language model cannot bypass the confirm panel; it never has direct execution rights. See the threat model in the engineering spec for the full argument.

Which language model should I use?

Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Buyers on strict data-sovereignty postures point Auto-Mate at a local Ollama or LM Studio. Buyers who want the fastest classify-and-plan latency use a small, fast cloud model with their own key. Local and cloud can be mixed: fast classifier local, larger planner in the cloud, or vice versa.

How does Auto-Mate work with Re-Kon?

If both live on the same machine, Auto-Mate reads Re-Kon's manifest from ~/.vf/agents/re-kon.toml and exposes the research capability in the input. Typing a research brief routes to Re-Kon over the local bus, and the completed dossier opens in a preview panel. Nothing traverses the network. See the compose section above for the exact flow.

What happens if VF Empire ever ends Auto-Mate?

The Permanence Guarantee applies. Within 90 days of end-of-life the full source is released under a permissive open licence, the last signed build stays verifiable in the public transparency log, and the workflow save format is documented so any conformant reader can replay your saved workflows. Your activated binary keeps working regardless.
